grammar: c
asserts: values, tql_tree, source_tree, bytecode

--- tql ---
. / function_definition.declarator as @func_decl
| [
  .parameters / parameter_declaration
  | select(.type | text = 'int')
  | .declarator
  | text
] as @int_param_names
| { func: @func_decl.declarator, @int_param_names }

--- source ---
int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
